summary: The public author table estimates long versus short photoperiod across the circadian day in 121 male mice. The registered analysis uses the 18 mice sampled at pZT12, and all 18 match the author sample sheet. No author-produced pZT12 gene effect was located in the paper, supplements, labelled panels, study deposits or code outputs.

manualReview.summary: The author DESeq2 result spans the circadian day. No author effect specific to projected ZT12 was located.
manualReview.note: The authors used one whole-SCN library per male mouse and short photoperiod as baseline. Their GitLab sample sheet has 121 mice across six projected times. All 18 registered pZT12 libraries are present, nine per photoperiod. The DESeq2 coefficient adjusts for RNA-extraction batch across the day. The registered edgeR quasi-likelihood coefficient uses only pZT12 and adjusts for sequencing batch (four and five mice per arm in batches 5209 and 5728). The archived journal S4 workbook retains legacy S2 sheet labels, addressed in the corrigendum. Its 16,856 genes and 15,873 numeric adjusted P values yield 1,518 whole-day calls at adjusted P < 0.05 and absolute log2FC > 0.1 (546 higher, 972 lower in long days). The labelled volcano genes inherit that coefficient. Phase-labelled points are expression means and the fitted curves describe rhythms. GEO supplies counts, and the code export appends normalized counts to the whole-day result. No pZT12 author effect or inference was available for comparison. Evidence and six comparability dimensions are recorded in data/author-validation/continued-sources/GSE266472/codex-2026-11-24/SEARCH_LOG.md.

verificationReview.reason: The published DESeq2 log2 fold change estimates the RNA-batch-adjusted photoperiod main effect across the sampled day. HypoExplorer estimates the sequencing-batch-adjusted effect within pZT12. Although the pZT12 library IDs agree, the supplement, code exports, gene browser and labelled figures provide no phase-specific coefficient. Registered effect and inference concordance are unassessed.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen for an author-produced long-versus-short pZT12 gene effect with identifiable SCN libraries, phase, baseline and batch handling. A selected list would cover only its named genes.
